moves.label: Trade: Brandon Ingram, Bruce Brown, Jr., Kelly Olynyk
moves.description: Brandon Ingram was acquired by the Toronto Raptors from the New Orleans Pelicans in exchange for: Bruce Brown, Jr., Kelly Olynyk, a conditional 2026 1st round pick (IND own), a 2031 2nd round pick (TOR own) and a TPE.

moves.label: Trade: Dennis Schroder, Lindy Waters III, K.J. Martin, P.J. Tucker, Davion Mitchell and others
moves.description: Dennis Schroder and Lindy Waters III were acquired by the Detroit Pistons in exchange for K.J. Martin, a Least Favorable 2028 2nd round pick, a Swap 2031 2nd round picks and cash. P.J. Tucker, a 2026 2nd round pick (LAL own) and cash were acquired by the Toronto Raptors in exchange for Davion Mitchell. Kyle Anderson, Davion Mitchell, Andrew Wiggins, a conditional 2025 1st round pick (GOS own), a Swap 2031 2nd round picks and multiple TPEs were acquired by the Miami Heat in exchange for Jimmy Butler III, Josh Richardson, a 2026 2nd round pick (LAL own) and cash. Jimmy Butler III, a Swap 2031 2nd round picks, cash and multiple TPEs were acquired by the Golden State Warriors in exchange for Kyle Anderson, Dennis Schroder, Lindy Waters III, Andrew Wiggins and a conditional 2025 1st round pick (GOS own). K.J. Martin, Josh Richardson, a Least Favorable 2028 2nd round pick, cash and a TPE were acquired by the Utah Jazz in exchange for P.J. Tucker and a Swap 2031 2nd round picks.

moves.label: Trade: James Wiseman
moves.description: A conditional 2026 2nd round pick (TOR own) and a TPE were acquired by the Indiana Pacers from the Toronto Raptors in exchange for: James Wiseman and cash.
